summary: Added a secure 512 MiB /swapfile on node1. It is active now, configured in /etc/fstab, and automatically recovered after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Created /swapfile with an exact size of 536,870,912 bytes
Set ownership root:root, mode 0600, and SELinux swapfile_t context
Initialized and activated the swap file
Safely rebooted node1 once and verified its boot identity changed
Confirmed the system recovered healthy with the swapfile.swap unit active and no failed units

evidence.requirement: 512 MiB swap file exists and is active
evidence.summary: Shows the exact 512 MiB file size, swap signature, secure permissions/context, and 536,866,816 usable swap bytes active before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Swap file activates after future boots
evidence.summary: Shows the single /swapfile fstab entry, healthy pre-restart activation, and post-restart swapfile.swap unit active with /swapfile present in the live swap inventory.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 636556ce-a308-49cc-b873-62cedb1c077d, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID f2dedc27-b221-4361-9ce6-ada76b18da19, and recovered system health, data, and swap state.
